# `log`

::: info
Başvuru metni WIT dosyalarından otomatik üretildiği için İngilizce.
:::

Logging to the server console or the client log. Lines are prefixed with the mod id by the host.

Package `blockheads:api@0.2.0` · Lua table `bh.log` · [WIT source](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/wit/blockheads-api/log.wit)

## Types

### `level` <Badge type="info" text="enum" />

Log severity.

| Case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `trace` | Very detailed output, hidden by default. |
| `debug` | Diagnostic output, hidden by default. |
| `info` | Normal messages. |
| `warn` | Something looks wrong but the mod keeps working. |
| `error` | Something failed. |

## Functions

### `log` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
log: func(level: level, message: string);
```

Writes one log line. Messages longer than 4096 bytes are truncated by the host.
